tithi.name: Shukla Shasthi
tithi.description: Fosters discipline, vitality, and victory over adversaries; highly revered for devotion to Lord Kartikeya and Surya.

Mesha.summary: Professional endeavors receive dynamic momentum as your authority expands.
Mesha.general: The Moon transits your tenth house of karma, blessing you with focus and professional acclaim. Superiors will appreciate your decisive and structured approach to ongoing responsibilities.
Mesha.career: High-impact meetings and strategic presentations are favored today. A collaborative initiative begun now promises solid, long-term stability.
Mesha.finance: Financial opportunities arise through enterprise and executive decisions. Maintain a steady budget while reviewing career-aligned investments.
Mesha.relationships: Balancing professional duty with domestic warmth will sustain family harmony. Make time to share your victories with loved ones.
Mesha.health: Vitality is elevated, though minor joint stiffness could occur. Ensure consistent hydration and moderate posture breaks throughout work hours.
Mesha.remedy: Offer water mixed with a pinch of red sandalwood to the Sun during sunrise.

Vrishabha.summary: Fortune smiles on your long-term vision, higher learning, and spiritual inclinations.
Vrishabha.general: With the Moon illuminating your ninth house of destiny, optimism and ethical clarity guide your choices. Guidance from a mentor or elder provides valuable perspective today.
Vrishabha.career: Opportunities connected with distant collaborations, research, or publishing flourish. Your composed demeanor facilitates smooth consensus in discussions.
Vrishabha.finance: Favorable indications for investments in knowledge, certifications, or ethical assets. Avoid speculation and honor disciplined savings practices.
Vrishabha.relationships: Meaningful conversations create a deeper philosophical bond with your partner. A spiritual or cultural outing brings domestic serenity.
Vrishabha.health: General well-being is robust and mental peace prevails. Gentle stretches or a contemplative walk in nature will enhance your vitality.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 11 times and offer white flowers to Lord Vishnu.

Mithuna.summary: Exercise quiet introspection and approach financial transformations with mindful caution.
Mithuna.general: The eighth house transit urges emotional resilience and analytical care in confidential matters. Take space for deep research rather than rushing into impulsive commitments.
Mithuna.career: Navigating complex institutional tasks requires meticulous attention to documentation. Stay discreet about your strategies until formal approvals arrive.
Mithuna.finance: Audit shared resources, taxes, and insurance portfolios for clarity. Defer large, non-essential monetary outlays to a more auspicious transit.
Mithuna.relationships: Honest yet compassionate communication dissolves underlying anxieties with your partner. Avoid magnifying trivial misunderstandings.
Mithuna.health: Pay attention to digestive rhythm and get adequate restful sleep. Incorporate herbal teas and reduce evening screen exposure.
Mithuna.remedy: Recite the Mahamrityunjaya Mantra three times before stepping out.

Karka.summary: Collaborations and marital bonds deepen through mutual trust and shared objectives.
Karka.general: Your sign ruler activates the seventh house, accentuating diplomacy, interpersonal harmony, and public rapport. Listening empathetically will yield fruitful alliances across all domains.
Karka.career: Joint ventures, negotiations, and client-facing roles experience beneficial breakthroughs. Your intuitive understanding of colleagues establishes productive synergy.
Karka.finance: Financial gains via commercial contracts or spousal support are highlighted. Ensure all partnership agreements are explicitly documented.
Karka.relationships: Romance flourishes through attentive gestures and shared domestic aspirations. Singles may encounter someone with an authentic, grounded worldview.
Karka.health: Energy levels remain stable when balanced with mindful hydration. Practice evening breathwork (Pranayama) to release lingering tension.
Karka.remedy: Offer raw milk and water on a Shiva Linga while meditating on inner peace.

Simha.summary: Productivity soars as you systematically clear pending obligations and conquer challenges.
Simha.general: The Moon moving through the sixth house empowers your problem-solving capacity and competitive strength. Your pragmatic attitude ensures quick resolution of lingering disputes.
Simha.career: A disciplined routine enables you to outperform competitors and complete intricate workloads. Subordinates and peers will follow your confident guidance.
Simha.finance: Prudent management helps settle existing dues or curb unnecessary expenditure. It is an ideal day to budget systematically for essential assets.
Simha.relationships: Avoid letting everyday workplace fatigue spill into your personal sanctuary. A kind, non-judgmental dialogue will restore domestic warmth.
Simha.health: Focus on gut wellness by eating fresh, warm meals and avoiding overly spiced food. Moderate physical exercise strengthens your stamina.
Simha.remedy: Feed soaked grains or birdseed to birds during early morning hours.

Kanya.summary: Creative insights, sharp intellect, and joyful expressions brighten your day.
Kanya.general: The fifth house transit sparks artistic flair, intellectual acuity, and warmth with younger generations. Trust your refined analytical skills when developing new ideas.
Kanya.career: Academic pursuits, technical design, and creative proposals will gain enthusiastic approval. Your logical articulation sets an inspiring benchmark at work.
Kanya.finance: Favorable conditions for long-term investments, provided they are thoroughly verified. Speculative risks should be moderated with sound wisdom.
Kanya.relationships: Heartfelt warmth enriches romantic relationships, making this a delightful day for bonding. Parents will derive immense joy from children's achievements.
Kanya.health: Mental agility is high, bringing a pleasant sense of vitality. Engage in light creative hobbies to maintain emotional equilibrium.
Kanya.remedy: Offer green grass (Durva) to Lord Ganesha and chant 'Om Gan Ganapataye Namah'.

Tula.summary: Cultivate domestic serenity and focus on strengthening your emotional foundation.
Tula.general: The Moon in your fourth house directs focus toward your residence, family well-being, and inner solace. Creating a peaceful ambiance at home will soothe any restless thoughts.
Tula.career: Focus on stabilizing ongoing initiatives rather than launching unpredictable ventures. Steady, methodic execution ensures dependable results.
Tula.finance: Expenditure toward property maintenance, family comfort, or vehicles is indicated. Ensure these expenses align with your predetermined monthly limits.
Tula.relationships: A compassionate approach toward maternal figures or elders creates great harmony. Sincere discussions at home bring comfort to everyone involved.
Tula.health: Guard against respiratory sensitivity or emotional weariness. Practicing gentle chest-opening yoga postures promotes vitality.
Tula.remedy: Light a pure cow ghee lamp near a Tulsi plant in the evening.

Vrischika.summary: Your courageous communication and proactive drive open promising new pathways.
Vrischika.general: Moving through your third house, the Moon bolsters your courage, networking abilities, and determination. Short-distance travels and vital communications bear constructive fruit.
Vrischika.career: Marketing, writing, public correspondence, and team leadership are strongly favored. Your persuasive articulation wins over hesitant stakeholders.
Vrischika.finance: Modest yet steady financial benefits manifest through communication channels and self-initiative. It is a good day to finalize promising contracts.
Vrischika.relationships: Bonds with siblings, cousins, and neighbors receive a joyful boost. Expressing appreciation openly strengthens mutual camaraderie.
Vrischika.health: Vitality is elevated, and you feel agile throughout the day. Channel your high energy into an active fitness routine or brisk walk.
Vrischika.remedy: Recite the Hanuman Chalisa to enhance courage and channel your drive constructively.

Dhanu.summary: Financial stability and thoughtful conversations bring peace to your family circle.
Dhanu.general: The Moon transits your second house of wealth and speech, encouraging refined expression and resource management. Your supportive words will act as a stabilizing force for relatives.
Dhanu.career: Consulting, banking, and advisory roles show marked efficiency today. Professional presentations benefit greatly from your courteous and articulate tone.
Dhanu.finance: A constructive phase for organizing family finances, deposits, and savings schemes. Guard against impulsive gourmet splurges.
Dhanu.relationships: Warmth and mutual respect define your interactions with family members. Enjoying a wholesome meal together nurtures emotional connectivity.
Dhanu.health: Pay attention to oral hygiene and soothe your throat with warm herbal concoctions. Moderate dietary choices ensure lasting vitality.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a subtle tilak of saffron or turmeric on your forehead after bathing.

Makara.summary: Emotional clarity, self-assurance, and personal magnetism define your journey today.
Makara.general: With the Moon transiting your lagna in Shravana nakshatra, your receptivity and personal presence are elevated. You radiate composed authority and inspire confidence in those around you.
Makara.career: Leadership initiatives take center stage as others rely on your balanced judgment. Strategic decisions executed today yield enduring professional credibility.
Makara.finance: Prioritize strategic financial planning that supports long-term independence. Favorable conditions support reviewing self-funded ventures.
Makara.relationships: Your calm, considerate demeanor makes you deeply attractive to your partner. Transparent dialogue strengthens romantic and personal bonds.
Makara.health: Physical endurance and mental tranquility are in harmonious balance. Continue mindful hydration and avoid overextending your evening schedule.
Makara.remedy: Offer mustard oil lamp beneath a Peepal tree in the evening while praying for stability.

Kumbha.summary: Embrace tranquil reflection, spiritual growth, and prudent management of resources.
Kumbha.general: The twelfth house transit invites you to rest, practice mindfulness, and reflect on personal growth. Solitary work and spiritual practices yield immense inner tranquility.
Kumbha.career: Tasks involving overseas entities, backstage planning, or research thrive under this transit. Avoid unnecessary office politics and maintain quiet focus.
Kumbha.finance: Expenditure may rise toward charitable causes, healthcare, or domestic upgrades. Keep track of transaction receipts to maintain fiscal balance.
Kumbha.relationships: Gentle, non-demanding presence is the best way to support your loved ones today. Give each other space for individual rejuvenation.
Kumbha.health: Ensure adequate, undisturbed sleep to refresh your nervous system. Evening meditation will calm mental chatter and restore equilibrium.
Kumbha.remedy: Donate black sesame seeds or dark-colored blankets to those in need.

Meena.summary: Auspicious gains, uplifting friendships, and long-desired milestones manifest gracefully.
Meena.general: The Moon illuminates your eleventh house of fulfillment and gains, creating an encouraging atmosphere. Collaborative ventures and interactions with supportive friends bring tangible progress.
Meena.career: Network expansion and cross-functional collaborations yield exceptional progress. Your contributions toward collective organizational goals will be praised.
Meena.finance: Inflow of pending receivables or supplementary income streams is brightly indicated. It is an opportune day to formulate ambitious wealth accumulation plans.
Meena.relationships: Social warmth is elevated, bringing delightful reunions with trusted companions. Mutual respect and laughter deepen romantic commitments.
Meena.health: Vibrant energy accompanies you throughout the day. Maintain physical wellness with balanced, seasonal nutrition and restorative walks.
Meena.remedy: Chant 'Om Namo Bhagavate Vasudevaya' 21 times while offering yellow flowers at an altar.

tithi.name: Shukla Shashthi
tithi.description: Sacred day dedicated to Lord Surya and Chhathi Maiya, highly auspicious for discipline, fasting, and spiritual elevation.

Mesha.summary: Professional endeavors gather strong momentum with prominent public recognition.
Mesha.general: The Moon transiting your tenth house bestows leadership acumen and purpose. You will navigate responsibilities with calm efficiency and dignity.
Mesha.career: Superior authorities appreciate your decisive contributions and organized strategy. A fruitful platform opens up for long-term project planning.
Mesha.finance: Monetary inflows remain steady through professional rewards and previous endeavors. Avoid premature investments in unverified speculative channels.
Mesha.relationships: Balancing career demands with domestic commitments deepens trust and harmony. Family elders offer blessings and valuable practical advice.
Mesha.health: Vitality is robust, though knee or joint strain needs mild stretching. Stay mindful of ergonomic posture during prolonged sitting.
Mesha.remedy: Offer water mixed with red sandalwood and jaggery to Lord Surya at sunrise.

Vrishabha.summary: Fortune smiles through philosophical pursuits, higher guidance, and intellectual breakthroughs.
Vrishabha.general: A spiritual aura envelops your day as the ninth house Moon aligns your focus with wisdom. Important decisions taken today bear long-lasting positive fruit.
Vrishabha.career: Mentors and senior colleagues provide strategic clarity for upcoming goals. Intellectual discussions and legal matters tilt favorably in your direction.
Vrishabha.finance: Financial stability strengthens through prudent planning and virtuous investments. Modest gains arrive through past academic or advisory consultancy.
Vrishabha.relationships: Meaningful conversations bring you closer to elders and philosophical mentors. Your calm demeanor resolves any subtle misunderstandings with your spouse.
Vrishabha.health: General wellbeing is favorable, fostering an upbeat mental state. Maintain mindful eating habits to support healthy digestion.
Vrishabha.remedy: Chant the Gayatri Mantra 11 times facing East during morning hours.

Mithuna.summary: Deep introspection and prudent caution unlock hidden inner strengths today.
Mithuna.general: With the Moon traveling through your eighth house, embrace contemplative calm rather than haste. Cultivating patience allows you to manage sudden schedule changes with grace.
Mithuna.career: Avoid initiating high-risk professional changes or confrontational dialogues today. Focus on meticulous research, back-office reviews, and audits.
Mithuna.finance: Scrutinize pending bills and joint financial liabilities with extreme care. Refrain from signing financial agreements without thorough validation.
Mithuna.relationships: Emotional sensitivity may run high; respond with patience rather than reactionary words. Compassionate listening will prevent domestic discord.
Mithuna.health: Prioritize restorative rest and hydration to alleviate seasonal sluggishness. Mindful breathing exercises help disperse lingering mental tension.
Mithuna.remedy: Apply a chandan tilak on your forehead and recite 'Om Namah Shivaya'.

Karka.summary: Partnerships thrive as shared aspirations find collaborative harmony and clear expression.
Karka.general: Your sign ruler illuminates the seventh house, enhancing mutual understanding and social magnetism. Collaborative alliances both in life and work yield pleasant outcomes.
Karka.career: Joint ventures and collaborative negotiations progress on remarkably productive terms. Your persuasive communication ensures fruitful consensus with stakeholders.
Karka.finance: Financial gains arise through collaborative trades or commercial partnerships. Keep domestic spending aligned with shared household budgets.
Karka.relationships: Marital warmth and romantic connections experience genuine closeness and tenderness. An evening spent together creates cherished memories.
Karka.health: Vital energy is solid, though adequate hydration is essential. Avoid heavy evening meals to support smooth digestion.
Karka.remedy: Offer raw milk and white flowers to a Shivling with sincere devotion.

Simha.summary: A triumph over obstacles and renewed daily discipline empower your productivity.
Simha.general: The Moon in your sixth house grants courage to surmount hurdles and organize daily routines. Your steady focus turns potential challenges into stepping stones.
Simha.career: You outshine competitors through meticulous execution and unmatched resilience. Pending workplace tasks reach completion ahead of planned timelines.
Simha.finance: Prudent budget management curtails unnecessary expenditures effectively. Favorable conditions assist in resolving small debts or dues.
Simha.relationships: Practical assistance extended to loved ones demonstrates your quiet commitment. Maintain gentle speech during household discussions.
Simha.health: Adopt wholesome dietary habits to maintain peak vitality. Engaging in brisk morning walks will boost your stamina.
Simha.remedy: Recite the Aditya Hridaya Stotra during sunrise for vigor and clarity.

Kanya.summary: Creative inspiration and emotional clarity bring delightful breakthroughs in learning and expression.
Kanya.general: The fifth house transit of the Moon sparks your intellect and artistic discernment. Engaging in creative hobbies or learning endeavors will bring immense satisfaction.
Kanya.career: Innovative solutions crafted by you earn applause from colleagues and clients. Strategic ideas shared in team forums find swift approval.
Kanya.finance: Speculative ventures should be approached with disciplined analysis, not impulsive optimism. Wise budgeting yields comfort and financial peace.
Kanya.relationships: Romantic connections flourish with joyful communication and thoughtful gestures. Children or younger kin bring moments of genuine pride.
Kanya.health: Mental cheerfulness promotes physical wellbeing and vitality. Engage in light yoga to maintain overall flexibility.
Kanya.remedy: Offer Durva grass to Lord Ganesha while chanting 'Om Gan Ganapataye Namah'.

Tula.summary: Focus turns toward domestic bliss, comfort, and rejuvenating your emotional roots.
Tula.general: With the Moon transiting the fourth house, finding inner tranquility and home harmony takes priority. Creating an organized living space soothes your mind.
Tula.career: Maintain steady focus on ongoing responsibilities without overextending commitments. Remote tasks or foundational planning yield the best outcomes today.
Tula.finance: Expenditures on home embellishment or family needs remain well within limits. Focus on establishing conservative, long-term asset growth.
Tula.relationships: Spending quality time with your mother or maternal figures brings deep emotional healing. Warm family discussions strengthen mutual trust.
Tula.health: Watch out for mild chest heaviness or seasonal cough due to climate shifts. Warm herbal infusions will keep your respiratory channels clear.
Tula.remedy: Light a ghee lamp in the temple of your home and chant the Sri Suktam.

Vrischika.summary: Courageous communication and purposeful initiatives yield commendable achievements.
Vrischika.general: The third house Moon activates enterprise, decisive vigor, and harmonious communication. Your self-confidence inspires trust among peers and siblings alike.
Vrischika.career: Short work-related communications, pitches, and writing endeavors prove fruitful. Collaborative efforts thrive under your proactive guidance.
Vrischika.finance: Financial gains through short travels or digital commercial channels look promising. Strategic investments in skill enhancement will pay high dividends.
Vrischika.relationships: Siblings and close neighbors provide heartfelt cooperation and cheer. Candid, uplifting conversations enhance relationship bonds.
Vrischika.health: Energy levels remain remarkably high throughout the day. Channel this physical stamina into an active workout or brisk walk.
Vrischika.remedy: Feed birds with soaked grains and chant the Hanuman Chalisa.

Dhanu.summary: Financial stability and eloquent speech enhance family prosperity and personal prestige.
Dhanu.general: The Moon moving through your second house highlights resource consolidation and refined speech. Your thoughtful words foster peace across both personal and professional spheres.
Dhanu.career: Presentations and negotiations conducted today yield favorable commitments. Your dependable work ethic draws constructive attention from management.
Dhanu.finance: Accumulated savings show a healthy trend through mindful expense management. An overdue financial payment or gift may pleasantly arrive.
Dhanu.relationships: Family gatherings or meals together radiate warmth and shared values. Your loving presence dissolves past lingering domestic tensions.
Dhanu.health: Pay attention to oral and throat care by drinking warm water. A wholesome, balanced vegetarian diet keeps you refreshed.
Dhanu.remedy: Apply a saffron or turmeric tilak on your forehead after bathing.

Makara.summary: Self-assurance, poise, and personal magnetic presence define your aura today.
Makara.general: With the Moon transiting your lagna, mental clarity and self-confidence reach peak levels. You lead by example and inspire those around you with calm grace.
Makara.career: Your strategic vision allows you to handle critical tasks effortlessly. Colleagues look up to your composure under tight deadlines.
Makara.finance: Personal investments and savings strategies show promising long-range security. Prudent self-discipline prevents unnecessary retail indulgences.
Makara.relationships: Your emotional balance brings assurance and warmth to your partner. Kind, clear communication dissolves any ambiguities in relationships.
Makara.health: Vitality is elevated, though mental quietude must be guarded against overthinking. A brief meditation session restores inner equilibrium.
Makara.remedy: Light a sesame oil lamp near a Peepal tree in the evening.

Kumbha.summary: Restful retreat, introspection, and spiritual pursuits bring deep mental rejuvenation.
Kumbha.general: The Moon in your twelfth house invites you to step back from bustling routines and rest. Quiet reflection will provide essential answers to complex questions.
Kumbha.career: Avoid taking on spontaneous commitments or entering contentious debates today. Focus on completing background tasks and planning future strategies privately.
Kumbha.finance: Watch out for unexpected domestic or philanthropic expenditures. Maintain a disciplined check on online impulse shopping.
Kumbha.relationships: Empathy and silence speak louder than words in resolving minor interpersonal friction. Solitude provides clarity before addressing important relationship discussions.
Kumbha.health: Ensure sound sleep and reduce late-night screen exposure to rest your eyes. Gentle breathing techniques will ease nervous exhaustion.
Kumbha.remedy: Donate warm clothing or food to an underprivileged person.

Meena.summary: Aspirations manifest as social networks and well-wishers rally to support your ambitions.
Meena.general: The Moon illuminating your eleventh house brings celebration, gains, and rewarding social engagements. Desired outcomes align smoothly with your sustained efforts.
Meena.career: Collaborative achievements and community goodwill boost your professional reputation. Networking leads to exciting avenues for future career expansion.
Meena.finance: Financial gains arrive through multiple channels or previous professional efforts. An investment made in the past starts showing promising returns.
Meena.relationships: Friendships bring genuine delight, camaraderie, and insightful perspectives. Romantic bonds flourish with joyful sharing of mutual dreams.
Meena.health: High spirits and positive energy keep physical fatigue at bay. Enjoy moderate outdoor activity to maintain physical vitality.
Meena.remedy: Chant the Brihaspati Beej Mantra 'Om Gram Greem Groum Sah Gurave Namah' 19 times.
